text:
maya: FYI partner AcmePayments pinged growth asking for a temporary burst increase on their webhook API keys during month-end reconciliation window. they want ~1000r/s for 2h tomorrow. current per-key burst is 200r/s. any safe way to do a scoped override? cc @alex @jonathan

alex: do we have precedent for timeboxed overrides? iirc we had a one-off for BetaRetail but it was manual and required sso approval.

jonathan: we have three levers: per-key burst, org-wide sustained qps, and short-lived escalation tokens. escalation tokens are what we used for BetaRetail — temp token with tighter logging + enforced TTL.

maya: escalation token sounds right. partner wants to use existing key though; they'd prefer not to swap keys mid-run. can we apply an override mapping that keeps their key but attaches a TTL and extra telemetry?

alex: yeah we can map key -> override policy in the quota service. proposal: create override record with fields: `expires_at`, `max_burst`, `audit_tag`. runtime checks precedence: override > per-key > org.

jonathan: sample override payload i was thinking about: ```json
{
  "key_id": "ak_live_abc123",
  "max_burst": 1000,
  "sustained_qps": 250,
  "expires_at": "2026-03-19T14:00:00Z",
  "reason": "month-end reconciliation - AcmePayments",
  "audit_tag": "partner-override-2026-03-acme"
}
```

eva: +1 but add `force_logging": true` so ops gets per-request traces for the window. also add `rate_limit_reason_code` so billing can tag it.

maya: ops concern: if we raise bursts a lot we might starve other shared pools on Dedicated nodes. can we route overridden traffic to a partner pool or throttle fallback to a cheaper model?

alex: routing is doable if partner is on Dedicated or we can pin them to a soft-partitioned pool. fallback policy could be `degrade_model_on_saturation` so we preserve latency for critical tenants. need to check capacity tomorrow AM.

jonathan: operational guardrails: 1) create override via console + require 2 approvers, 2) set TTL <= 4h, 3) auto-revert and run regression check on 30m token sample, 4) enable `elevated_audit` with full headers.

maya: sounds good. i'll draft a short console flow for self-serve partner overrides (console button -> modal collects `key, window, max_burst, reason` -> requires 2 approvers). leaving to eng-platform to wire the backend endpoint `/admin/overrides`.

alex: backend notes: endpoint should validate `max_burst <= 5x baseline` unless flagged by SRE. also emit a `override.created` event to telemetry with `created_by` and `approvers`.

ops-bot: reminder: any override must be accompanied by pre-announce in #incidents if expected to increase peak by >20% so oncall is aware :bell:

maya: i'll coordinate with account and AcmePayments for a quick rehearsal today. will open the console PR and ping here once ready. :thumbsup:

jonathan: last nit — include a soft kill switch: if node saturation > 85% for 5min, auto-disable overrides and notify #eng-sre.

alex: agree. i'll add alerts and a circuit breaker to the quota service.

maya: thanks all, filing follow-ups: 1) console modal pr, 2) quota service endpoint + validation, 3) telemetry event + audit fields, 4) routing checklist for Dedicated. will attach the partner request to the ticket.
